fish.warmupPolicy: Selected/restored live Fish only. Original1x HEVC readiness, then one board-route original-SVG embedded WebP lease only on authored fallback selection/failure. Weak cancellation/epoch guards retire background, generation, seek and resource replies; no global bitmap cache, asset conversion or independent ticker. Default-off common meter carrier prepares only selected original backpack/crate art; selected finale warmup is a separate actual receipt, not inferred from carrier/face readiness. Exact original same-node handoff is retained; whole Scene activation remains open.
fish.cleanupPolicy: NativeBoardScene generation and scene disposal retire tile/effect/media owners. NativeGameplayViewController retires visible finite carriers on generation replacement and disposal; background retains captured gameplay transactions and the last safe save while suspending accepted visual ownership; app wall callbacks remain independent. Late callbacks cannot reclaim another session.
fish.hudDepthPolicy: One SpriteKit board/HUD compositor, shared above-HUD effect depth and native UIKit foreground carriers for authored video/3D text. Larger art does not change stable gameplay hit footprint.
fish.status: IN PROGRESS. Source179 actual SVG browser poses/all72 frames and1,253 transforms verified; healthy native HEVC already passed actual Simulator. Original SVG fallback has native SDK proof and actual Simulator resource/geometry/drag/background/generation/foreground suite PASS. Full gameplay/shared phase and physical acceptance remain tracked in parity matrix.
fish.physicalAcceptance: NEEDS PHYSICAL TEST: active simultaneous copies, rendered outputs, FPS, memory and thermal. No emitter/timing/asset reduction authorized.
